## Why This Is Asked

```javascript
// Pseudo-masking policy evaluation
function maskValue(value, rule) {
  if (rule.type === 'redact') return 'REDACTED'
  if (rule.type === 'hash') return hash(value)
  if (rule.type === 'tokenize') return tokenize(value)
  return value
}
```

```javascript
  view.lastSeq = delta.seq;
}
```

```javascript
}
```
